newsitem.title: USA: A.M. Best puts Americo Life ratings under review.
newsitem.headline: A.M. Best puts Americo Life ratings under review.

text.p: Insurance ratings firm A.M. Best Co said on Friday it had placed its ratings on the Americo Life Group and B.A.T Industries Plc's Farmers Life units that Americo is buying under review.
Americo Life agreed to acquire Ohio State Life Insurance and Investors Guaranty Life Insurance from B.A.T's Farmers Life unit for about $330 million, B.A.T said yesterday.

A.M. Best said it will review the "A" (excellent) ratings of Great Southern Life Insurance Co and College Life Insurance of America; the "B+" (very good) ratings of Loyalty Life Insurance Co and National Farmers Union Life Insurance Co; and the "5" (average) financial performance ratings of United Fidelity Life Insurance Co and Financial Assurance Inc.

Also, the "A-" (excellent) rating of Ohio State Life Insurance Co. and the "B++" (very good) rating of Investors Guaranty Life Insurance Co, both of Columbus, Ohio and members of the Farmers Insurance Group, have been placed under review with developing implications, A.M. Best said.
The "A+" (superior) Best rating of Farmers New World Life Insurance Co is unaffected by the deal, A.M. Best said.
